payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped self-hosted single-box mediasoup SFU behind MediaPlaneAdapter: SfuBackend abstraction (local shapes, no mediasoup on typecheck path), MediasoupSfuBackend (lazy import), deterministic FakeSfuBackend, SfuMediaPlaneAdapter (allocate=1 router/call idempotent + bootstrap caps; issueJoinToken=send+recv transports + ICE/DTLS + HMAC nonce; release closes router), MediaPlacement seam w/ LocalMediaPlacement (FR-154 multi-node deferred). mediasoup is optionalDependency (gate untouched; pnpm ignores native build). Opt-in, default unchanged. Gate green: typecheck 0, server vitest 1038 passed/0 failed. Client-driver became follow-up FR-155.
